description: Get design. Get a single design by ID, including HTML content. front_preview_url and back_preview_url are public images of the card, made about a minute after each save that changes its artwork. They show the published version, or the draft when nothing is published, so edits saved without publishing are not in them; say so when that applies. After creating or updating a design, give the user both links and ask them to check the card. You cannot see these images, so never say the card looks right or matches a reference. An empty link usually means the preview is still being made: tell the user and read the design again in about a minute. A side with no artwork never gets a preview, and if a link is still empty after about two minutes, ask the user to check the card in DealMachine instead of waiting longer. Retrieves data without changing records or spending credits.
name: dealmachine_get_mail_designs_id
